results.rationale: Consistency: White background, blue woven upholstery and tapered brown legs remain; excluding viewpoint-dependent visibility, the back construction changes from a row of rounded cushions to two broad rigid rectangular sections with a narrow raised central section. Instruction: The side view becomes a rear-facing view with large back panels; the required front view should expose three back cushions, seat cushions and a right-hand projecting chaise as in the reference. The change is in the wrong direction. Quality: Assessed alone, the rear-facing furniture rendering has clean edges, coherent panel geometry and legs, uniform woven fabric and no noticeable generation artifacts.

Consistency: The foot orientation, dark sock and exposed hairy ankle remain recognizable, but the ankle/cuff contour and crop change, knit texture is visibly redrawn across the sock, and the backdrop becomes more strongly teal. These extend beyond closing the heel hole. Instruction: The exposed skin hole at the lower heel is replaced by continuous dark knitted material; a completed sock should have no opening there, and the edit fully closes it. Quality: The foot and sock have a coherent silhouette, continuous plausible fabric, natural contact with the dark surface and no distracting artifacts; softness does not obscure their meaning.
